content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Clone - Emails ## slug: clone-emails ## seoTitle: Clone - Emails ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End You can now configure and manage emails from within the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} when editing existing {{variable.Object_Event}}s. The “Emails” section is located in the left-side navigation under Attendees. ## Email Templates Related List Start by clicking the Emails tab in the left-hand navigation bar. ![EventBuilder_Edit_EmailsTab](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_Edit_EmailsTab.png){height="" width=""} If there are {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}s related to the {{variable.Object_Event}}, they will appear here. You can also create new {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}s by clicking {{variable.button_new}} in the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} component. Select “New” to create a new template or select “New from Template” to use an existing template. ![EventBuilder_EmailsTab_CreateEmailTemplate_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailsTab_CreateEmailTemplate_1.png){height="" width=""} ### New 1. If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field on your {{variable.Object_Event}} contains an image, it will appear in the gray box that says, “Drop your file here.” To replace the image or If the space is blank, click **Browse**. ![EventBuilder_EmailsTab_EmailTemplate_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailsTab_EmailTemplate_2.png){height="" width=""} 2. Click **Upload**, **Import**, or **Search free photos** to add images. * Use the **Upload** button to add an image locally from your computer. * Use the **Import** button to add an image via Facebook, Dropbox, One Drive, etc. ![EventBuilder_EmailTab_Template_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailTab_Template_3.png){height="" width=""} * To upload an image via Salesforce Files, click **Import**, copy the public link from your image, and paste it in the “Enter a URL” box. ![EventBuilder_EmailTab_Template_4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailTab_Template_4.png){height="" width=""} * Click the **X** below the **Cancel** button to return to the previous screen. 3. To customize your {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} further, complete the following steps. * Use the options in the Rows section to change each row’s layout. * Drag and drop the icons from the Content section onto the template. You can add more images, buttons, dividers, social media links, videos, and more. * Use the options in the Settings section to set the background color, background image, default font, and more. For more information about configuring your {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/email-template-builder){target=`_blank`}. ### New from Template 1. If you choose “New from Template,” select an {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} (required). 2. Click **Continue**. ![EventBuilder_EmailsTab_Template_5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailsTab_Template_5.png){height="" width=""} 3. Use the options in the Content, Rows, and Settings sections to edit your {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}. For more information about how the Email Template Builder works, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/email-template-builder){target=`_blank`}. ## Email Configuration Component 1. Review/Edit the following fields. * {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} (required) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ConfirmatioEmail}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistedEmail}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlisPendEmail}} ![EventBuilder_EmailsTab_ConfigurationComponent](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailsTab_ConfigurationComponent.png){height="" width=""} 2. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Send Email Instantaneously Component 1. Review/edit the following fields. * {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} (required) – Select the from email address. The field defaults to the current user. Add an email address to the Organization-Wide Email Addresses to automatically include it as a picklist option. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EmailTemplate}} (required) – Select the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} you want to use. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AttendeeFilter}} – This field controls which {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s will receive the email. * “Registration Status” - Select “Registration Status” (Invited, Registered, etc.) to select {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s with a specific {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}}. * “Attendee Status” - Select “Attendance Status” (Attended, No Show, etc.) to select {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s with a specific {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendancStatus}}. * {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_StatusFilter}} for “Registration Status” – Choose from Lead, To Invite, Invited, Pending, Registered, Declined, Canceled, Waitlisted – Pending, Waitlisted – Rejected, Awaiting Approval, or Rejected. * {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_StatusFilter}} for “Attendee Status” – Choose from Pending, Attended, or No-Show. ![EventBuilder_EmailsTab_SendEmailInstant](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventBuilder_EmailsTab_SendEmailInstant.png){height="" width=""} 2. You’ll now see the list of {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s the email will be sent to. 3. Click **Preview Email** to preview the email or click **Send**. ## Schedule Emails with the Smart Scheduler The Smart Scheduler’s email functionality is available from the Email tab in Event Builder when cloning or editing an existing {{variable.Object_Event}}. It is not available when creating a new {{variable.Object_Event}}. 1. Scroll down to the Smart Scheduler or Messages section. 2. Select Schedule “an Email.” 3. Select “Event Attendees” or “Session Attendees.” ### Recipients Section 1. Enter a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_ScheduleName}}. 2. Select a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_FromEmailAddre}} or the person that the email will be sent from. 3. Select a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_ToEmail}} from the following options. * “{{variable.Field_Attendee_Email}} (conference360__Email2__c)” * “{{variable.Field_Attendee_InviteSentTo}} (conference360__Invite_Sent_To__c)” * “{{variable.Field_Attendee_PrimaryEmail}} (conference360__Primary_Email__c)” * “Select FROM Parent” 4. Choose an {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AttendeeFilter}}. * If you set {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AttendeeFilter}} = “Attendance Status”, select the relevant options in the {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendancStatus}} field. * If you set {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AttendeeFilter}} = “Registration Status”, select the relevant options in the {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} field. 9. There must be at least one recipient listed in {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}}. You can click the “number” under {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}} to see who the recipients are. If a zero is listed under {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}}, check that you have the correct status selected and review the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s that should have the chosen status. 10. Confirm that the amount under {{variable.Field_SmartSche_EmailBalance}} is greater than the number of {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}}. 11. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. ### Schedule Section 1. Choose one of the three options below to schedule your email. * Send the email at a specific date and time * Choose the specific date and time in the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_SelectDateTime}} field. * Send the email X Minutes/Hours/Days After/Before the selected trigger. * Enter the number. * Choose “Days”, “Hours”, or “Minutes”. * Select “Before” or “After”. * Choose “Event Start Date/Time”, Event End Date/Time”, “Event Attendee Registration Date”, or “Event Attendee Created Date”. * Select {{variable.Field_SmartSche_Now}} to send the email two minutes after the email is scheduled. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. ### Message Section 1. Choose “Select Template” or “Compose Email.” * Select Template: In the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EmailTemplate}} field, search for an existing {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} or click **Create New** to create a new one. * Compose Email: Enter a {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTemp_Subject}} and a {{variable.Field_SMSTemplate_Body}} for the email. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. ### Send Test Section 1. Enter a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TestEmail}}. Make sure to use an email that can be checked easily. Using your email is a good option. 2. Select a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TestRecord}}. 3. Click **Send Test**. When you are ready to send the email, click **Schedule**. The scheduled email will appear in the Messages section.
